sample_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_details sd INNER JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON sh.source_id = sd.sample_header_id WHERE sh.isactive = true

sample_count_pending_review.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE status IN ('Samples Request Review', 'Sample Verification', 'Sample Approval') AND isactive = true GROUP BY status
sample_count_pending_review.description: Batch counts awaiting laboratory review, verification, or final approval sign-off

sample_count_in_lab.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_details sd INNER JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON sh.source_id = sd.sample_header_id INNER JOIN reporting.sample_analysis_stages sas ON sas.source_id = sh.sample_tracking_stage WHERE sas.sample_workflow = 'Samples In Lab' AND sh.isactive = true
sample_count_in_lab.description: Individual sample items currently in the lab

batch_count_in_lab.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers sh INNER JOIN reporting.sample_analysis_stages sas ON sas.source_id = sh.sample_tracking_stage WHERE sas.sample_workflow = 'Samples In Lab' AND sh.isactive = true
batch_count_in_lab.description: Sample batches (headers) currently in the lab

samples_by_status.sql: SELECT sh.status, COUNT(sd.source_id) as cnt FROM reporting.sample_details sd INNER JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON sh.source_id = sd.sample_header_id WHERE sh.isactive = true GROUP BY sh.status ORDER BY cnt DESC
samples_by_status.description: Distribution of samples across workflow stages

batch_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true

inventory_low_stock.sql: SELECT c.name as category, sc.name as subcategory, ii.batch_code, ii.stock_in, sc.minimum_level FROM reporting.inventory_items ii INNER JOIN reporting.inventory_sub_categories sc ON ii.inventory_sub_category_id = sc.source_id INNER JOIN reporting.inventory_categories c ON sc.inventory_category_id = c.source_id WHERE ii.stock_in < sc.minimum_level ORDER BY (sc.minimum_level - ii.stock_in) DESC LIMIT 10
inventory_low_stock.description: Items below minimum reorder level (shortage analysis)

inventory_order_status.sql: SELECT io.order_number, s.name as supplier, io.status as fulfillment_status, io.created_at FROM reporting.inventory_orders io LEFT JOIN reporting.suppliers s ON io.supplier_id = CAST(s.source_id AS VARCHAR) WHERE io.status IN ('not_fulfilled', 'partially_fulfilled') ORDER BY io.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

equipment_utilization.sql: SELECT e.equipment_name as name, COUNT(eu.source_id) as usage_count, MAX(eu.log_date) as last_used FROM reporting.equipment_assets e LEFT JOIN reporting.equipment_logs eu ON e.source_id = eu.equipment_id WHERE eu.log_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.source_id, e.equipment_name ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 10
equipment_utilization.description: Instrument usage statistics for the last 30 days

equipment_maintenance_schedule.sql: SELECT equipment_name, CAST(next_maintenance_date AS DATE) as next_maintenance_due, department_name as assigned_department FROM reporting.equipment_assets WHERE next_maintenance_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' AND maintenance_status != 'overdue' ORDER BY next_maintenance_date LIMIT 10

equipment_downtime_summary.sql: SELECT equipment_name, asset_code FROM reporting.equipment_assets WHERE maintenance_status = 'overdue' OR is_maintenance_overdue = 1 ORDER BY next_maintenance_date ASC LIMIT 5

qc_pass_rate.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completions FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND approval_date_at IS NOT NULL

qc_drifting_analytes.sql: SELECT analyte_name, robust_cv_pct, pass_rate_pct FROM reporting.v_qc_stability_metrics WHERE robust_cv_pct > 15 ORDER BY robust_cv_pct DESC
qc_drifting_analytes.description: Analytes showing warning or critical instability

capa_pending.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.corrective_actions WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(status_name, '')) NOT IN ('closed', 'completed', 'cancelled')
